items.text: Google previewed Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API, loading tool schemas only when needed to reduce prompt tokens and latency for large agent tool libraries.
items.text_zh: 谷歌预览 Gemini API 的工具检索功能，仅在需要时加载工具参数，以降低大型智能体工具库的提示词令牌与延迟。
items.cat_take_en: This directly tackles tool-library bloat, benefiting complex agents while leaving schema-selection accuracy as the key constraint.
items.cat_take_zh: 它直接缓解工具库膨胀，利好复杂智能体；但按需选对工具仍是落地瓶颈。

items.text: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore added Strands defaults, built-in tools, prompt caching, context management, and lifecycle hooks for controlling agent tool calls.
items.text_zh: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 新增 Strands 默认配置、内置工具、提示缓存、上下文管理及智能体工具调用生命周期钩子。
items.cat_take_en: Lifecycle hooks make consequential actions governable, but wildcard tool access can silently expand an application’s security boundary.
items.cat_take_zh: 生命周期钩子让关键操作可治理，但通配工具权限也可能悄然扩大应用的安全边界。

items.text: Cognition launched Devin Security Threats, a managed index tracking newly emerging vulnerabilities such as Java4Shell and NGINX2Root.
items.text_zh: Cognition 发布 Devin Security Threats，建立托管索引追踪 Java4Shell、NGINX2Root 等新出现的漏洞威胁。
items.cat_take_en: A managed threat feed could shorten agent response times, but its value depends on coverage speed and analyst-quality validation.
items.cat_take_zh: 托管威胁库有望缩短智能体响应时间，但价值取决于覆盖速度与人工研判质量。

items.text: Sakana AI signed a memorandum with Salesforce to deploy its models in Japanese public-sector software and develop government-focused AI applications.
items.text_zh: Sakana AI 与 Salesforce 签署备忘录，计划将其模型部署到日本公共部门软件，并开发面向政府的人工智能应用。
items.cat_take_en: The partnership gives Sakana an institutional route to deployment, while public-sector procurement and accountability remain unresolved hurdles.
items.cat_take_zh: 合作为 Sakana 打开机构部署通道，但公共部门采购与问责仍是尚未解决的障碍。

items.text: AI drug-discovery startup Boltz raised $110 million to accelerate small-molecule research.
items.text_zh: 人工智能药物发现初创公司 Boltz 筹集 1.1 亿美元，用于加速小分子药物研究。
items.cat_take_en: The round signals investor confidence in AI-enabled chemistry, but clinical translation—not model novelty—will determine returns.
items.cat_take_zh: 这轮融资显示资本看好 AI 化学，但最终回报仍取决于临床转化而非模型新奇度。

items.text: Kling 4.0 added native 4K resolution and 10-bit HDR output in both 4K and 1080p modes.
items.text_zh: 可灵 4.0 在 4K 与 1080p 模式中新增原生 4K 分辨率和 10-bit HDR 输出。
items.cat_take_en: Higher dynamic range improves production readiness, but creator adoption will hinge on generation speed and export costs.
items.cat_take_zh: 更高动态范围提升了制作成熟度，但创作者是否采用仍取决于生成速度与导出成本。

items.text: Goodfire released a searchable atlas of language-model neurons, grouping neuron poles by labels inferred from their maximally activating examples.
items.text_zh: Goodfire 发布可搜索的语言模型神经元图谱，依据最大激活样本推断的标签对神经元极性进行分组。
items.cat_take_en: Searchable interpretability lowers research friction, but inferred labels still risk turning suggestive correlations into false explanations.
items.cat_take_zh: 可检索图谱降低了解释研究门槛，但推断标签仍可能把相关性误当成真实解释。

items.text: Unsloth collaborated with AMD to bring local model inference to AMD NPUs, claiming two-to-four-times lower power use than traditional GPUs.
items.text_zh: Unsloth 与 AMD 合作将本地模型推理带到 AMD NPU，并称其功耗比传统 GPU 低两至四倍。
items.cat_take_en: Lower power could broaden local AI deployment, but real advantage depends on software support across AMD’s fragmented hardware stack.
items.cat_take_zh: 低功耗可能扩大本地 AI 部署，但实际优势取决于 AMD 分散硬件生态的软件支持。

items.text: Sourcegraph reported that 54% of AI-using engineering teams say more than 60% of generated code needs significant human rework before shipping.
items.text_zh: Sourcegraph 称，54% 使用 AI 的工程团队表示，超过 60% 的生成代码在发布前仍需大量人工返工。
items.cat_take_en: The figure challenges productivity hype: coding agents may shift labor from typing code to reviewing and repairing it.
items.cat_take_zh: 这一数字动摇了生产力神话：编码智能体可能只是把劳动从写代码转向审查与修复。

items.text: Pinecone introduced a Cost and Usage Export API that lets enterprise finance teams export project and index spending in the FOCUS format.
items.text_zh: Pinecone 推出成本与使用量导出 API，企业财务团队可按 FOCUS 格式导出项目和索引支出。
items.cat_take_en: Standardized cost exports make vector infrastructure easier to govern, benefiting finance teams more than model builders.
items.cat_take_zh: 标准化成本导出让向量基础设施更易治理，受益最大的是财务团队而非模型开发者。

items.text: Superhuman unveiled a personal AI assistant and expanded Go across its entire productivity suite.
items.text_zh: Superhuman 发布个人人工智能助手，并将 Go 功能扩展到整个生产力套件。
items.cat_take_en: Embedding assistance across the suite increases switching costs, but the product must prove it can coordinate work rather than merely draft text.
items.cat_take_zh: 全套件嵌入助手会提高用户黏性，但产品必须证明能协调工作，而不只是生成文字。

items.text: Amazon SageMaker AI added detection for latency drift, idle GPUs, and missed optimization opportunities on inference endpoints.
items.text_zh: Amazon SageMaker AI 新增推理端点延迟漂移、GPU 闲置和优化遗漏检测功能。
items.cat_take_en: Operational observability targets AI’s hidden waste, helping platform owners recover capacity before rising inference bills become permanent.
items.cat_take_zh: 运维可观测性直击 AI 隐性浪费，帮助平台方在推理账单固化前回收算力。

items.text: Together AI launched a storage accelerator that caches data from S3-compatible storage and Hugging Face on GPU clusters.
items.text_zh: Together AI 上线存储加速器，可将 S3 兼容对象存储和 Hugging Face 数据缓存到 GPU 集群。
items.cat_take_en: Faster data access attacks a major training bottleneck, but caching economics matter most for teams repeatedly reusing large corpora.
items.cat_take_zh: 更快数据访问直击训练瓶颈，但只有反复复用大型语料的团队才能真正获得经济收益。

items.text: OpenAI said GPT-Live-1.1, already powering voice in ChatGPT, is now available to developers building reliable voice agents.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 表示，已在 ChatGPT 中提供语音能力的 GPT-Live-1.1 现已开放给开发者，用于构建可靠的语音智能体。
items.cat_take_en: Opening the production voice stack could accelerate conversational apps, while latency and speech-safety failures remain costly risks.
items.cat_take_zh: 开放成熟语音栈可能加速对话应用，但延迟与语音安全失误仍会带来高昂风险。

items.text: Google’s AI agent improved Harness task success eightfold after changing only one line of code, according to an IT之家 report.
items.text_zh: 据 IT之家报道，谷歌人工智能智能体仅修改一行代码后，Harness 任务成功率提升了八倍。
items.cat_take_en: An eightfold gain from one change exposes fragile agent baselines, making evaluation discipline more important than headline scores.
items.cat_take_zh: 一处改动带来八倍提升，暴露智能体基线的脆弱性，也让评测纪律比 headline 分数更重要。

items.text: Meta’s Muse Wonder earned the highest overall quality score in Legora’s November BAR benchmark for legal work, according to Meta FAIR.
items.text_zh: Meta FAIR 表示，Muse Wonder 在 Legora 十一月法律工作 BAR 基准测试中取得最高综合质量分。
items.cat_take_en: A domain benchmark win gives Muse credibility with legal buyers, but one external score cannot establish dependable courtroom performance.
items.cat_take_zh: 领域基准夺冠增强了 Muse 对法律客户的说服力，但单项外部成绩不能证明法庭表现可靠。
